items.text: Baltimore QB: Lamar Jackson (thumb) on IR and Tyler Huntley out for the season; Jacoby Brissett starts again. The schedule still lists Huntley.

Baltimore (final): OUT - DT Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring), CB Marlon Humphrey (personal), S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee). No questionables. Sat: DT David Olajiga and TE Nick Vannett elevated. IR - C Ethan Pocic, G Jovaughn Gwyn, K Tyler Loop.

Carolina (final): OUT - LB Bobby Okereke (foot), S Isaiah Simmons (knee, moved to IR Sat); a third player (possibly DT Matt Ioannidis) may also be out - unconfirmed. QUESTIONABLE - RB Jonathon Brooks (groin), TEs Tommy Tremble and Darren Waller (knees), OL Brady Christensen (hamstring), CB Mike Jackson (groin, activated from IR Sat). OT Ikem Ekwonu PUP, OT Taylor Moton and CB Jaycee Horn IR. Bryce Young starts.

adjust.reason: Baltimore is without three defensive starters (DT Madubuike, CB Humphrey, S Hawkins) on top of its interior-line injuries, while Carolina's two outs are partly offset by questionable tags rather than absences. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
